rounds.text: Arvaya Healthcare Ltd is currently exhibiting powerful momentum, evidenced by a 360.4% twelve-month price return and a perfect relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E28, E29]. This market-beating performance is supported by a technical setup where the price sits above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E27]. The company’s intrinsic value, calculated via discounted cash flow, sits at Rs 426 per share, offering a substantial 74.7% margin of safety against the current market price [E22, E23]. Furthermore, management is demonstrating strong conviction in the company's future, as evidenced by promoters increasing their stake from 7.74% to 30.62% in less than three years [E20]. The business also benefits from a favorable macro backdrop, with the services sector currently identified as a tailwind [E42, E44]. Conceded: the company faces significant operational challenges, including negative operating and free cash flow [E17, E18], a lack of dividend payments [E3], and poor profitability metrics compared to sector benchmarks [E8, E9].
